title: External cup with one becomes scalar projection pullback under the unit coefficients
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $X,Y$ schemes over $k$ with structure morphisms $f,g$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base], and $P=X\times_kY$ [def-pc-fibre-product] with projections $p_X,p_Y$. Put $F=\mathcal O_X$, $G=\mathcal O_Y$ and $E=p_X^*F\otimes p_Y^*G$ [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. Let $\epsilon_X:p_X^*F\to\mathcal O_P$ and $\epsilon_Y:p_Y^*G\to\mathcal O_P$ be the adjoint structure maps [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-structure-sheaf], and put $m=\lambda_{\mathcal O_P}\circ(\epsilon_X\otimes\epsilon_Y):E\to\mathcal O_P$. Let $u_X,u_Y$ be the explicitly constructed degree-zero classes of one [lem-sc-scalar-unit-cohomology-coordinates]. Then for all $a\in H_k^1(X,F)$, $m_*(a\boxtimes u_Y)=(\epsilon_X)_*p_X^*a$, and for all $b\in H_k^1(Y,G)$, $m_*(u_X\boxtimes b)=(\epsilon_Y)_*p_Y^*b$. Every operation here is the scalar module-cohomology operation; no abelian comparison is involved.

proof.text: The augmented section one represents the degree-zero class. Its scalar Ext comparison is the scalar-unit morphism by evaluation at one. The projection coefficient maps preserve this cocycle, by their adjunction-unit formulas and preservation of one by structure-sheaf ring maps.

Use an acyclic computing tensor pairing extending the tensor of sections. Compose with the two adjoint unit maps and the tensor unitor: sectionwise s tensor one and one tensor s both map to s. This identifies the paired cycles and boundaries with the pulled-back cycles and boundaries. The scalar Ext tensor construction computes the same pairing. Pass to cohomology to obtain both identities. There is no interchange sign in degrees (1,0) or (0,1).

theorem external_cup_unit_coefficient_identities (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :
    let F := SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf
    let G := SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf
    let p := pullback.fst f g ≫ f
    let m := (tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit (pullback.fst f g) ⊗ₘ
      tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit (pullback.snd f g)) ≫
        (λ_ (SheafOfModules.unit (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback f g).ringCatSheaf)).hom
    (∀ a : scalarCohomology f F 1,
      scalarCohomologyMap p m 1
          (externalCup f g F G 1 0 a (scalarUnitCohomologyClass g)) =
        scalarCohomologyMap p (tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit (pullback.fst f g)) 1
          (scalarCohomologyPullback f p (pullback.fst f g) rfl F 1 a)) ∧
    (∀ b : scalarCohomology g G 1,
      scalarCohomologyMap p m 1
          (externalCup f g F G 0 1 (scalarUnitCohomologyClass f) b) =
        scalarCohomologyMap p (tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit (pullback.snd f g)) 1
          (scalarCohomologyPullback g p (pullback.snd f g) pullback.condition.symm G 1 b))
